conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hi, I'm 26 years old, and I'm female. I'm here because my left elbow has been really bothering me. It's been stiff and painful, especially after work, and I've noticed some swelling at the tip of my elbow.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Can you describe the nature of the pain in your left elbow? Is it a sharp, dull, burning, or throbbing sensation? Have you experienced any recent trauma or overuse activities that might have contributed to the pain? Additionally, have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your hand or forearm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain is more of a dull ache, and it's been bothering me a lot after I type all day at work. I don't think I've had any recent trauma, just repetitive motion. I haven't had any numbness or tingling, but there's a little bit of weakness in my arm, though nothing too bad.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you clarify the exact location of the pain and swelling in your elbow, and whether there is any limitation in your range of motion?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain and swelling are right at the tip of my left elbow, near the back. It's really stiff, and it hurts when I try to straighten or bend my elbow. It makes typing difficult, but I can still write with my non-dominant hand, which is good.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide information about any prior injuries or conditions affecting your elbow, as well as any family history of joint or musculoskeletal disorders? Additionally, are you currently taking any medications or supplements?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't have any prior injuries to my elbow, and I don't think there's a family history of joint issues. I'm currently taking Keppra for my epilepsy and Protonix for my peptic ulcer disease. That's it.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please describe the duration of your elbow pain and swelling? For example, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they been gradually worsening or sudden in onset?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain and swelling in my elbow have been going on for a few weeks now. It started gradually, and it's gotten worse over time, especially after I type all day. It's been pretty consistent, and the stiffness and pain are getting more noticeable each day.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you undergone any imaging studies such as X-rays, MRI, or ultrasound of the left elbow? If so, please provide the results. If not, would you be willing to undergo imaging to further evaluate the elbow?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I haven't had any imaging studies done for my elbow yet. I'm willing to undergo imaging if it would help figure out what's going on.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your vital signs and let me know if you've had any blood tests done recently?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: My vital signs were checked in the office, and everything looked good. I haven't had any blood tests done recently, just the endoscopy for my ulcer.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide the results of any previous blood tests, such as inflammatory markers (e.g., ESR, CRP) or rheumatologic panels, that may have been done for your elbow or other conditions?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't have any results from previous blood tests for inflammatory markers or rheumatologic panels. I was told during my endoscopy that I had gastritis, but that was for my ulcer, not for my elbow. I haven't had any blood tests specifically for my elbow.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any specific activities or movements that make the pain worse, or any that provide relief?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain gets worse when I type all day, especially when I'm using my left elbow on the desk. It also hurts when I try to straighten or bend my elbow. The only thing that seems to help a little is resting my elbow and applying ice.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you had any imaging studies, such as X-rays or an MRI, of your left elbow evaluated by a healthcare provider? Also, have you had any blood tests for inflammatory markers such as ESR or CRP, or for rheumatologic conditions such as rheumatoid factor or anti-CCP antibodies?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any imaging studies of my left elbow evaluated by a healthcare provider. I also haven't had any blood tests for inflammatory markers or rheumatologic conditions. The only test I had was an endoscopy for my ulcer, which showed gastritis.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any morning stiffness in the elbow, and if so, how long does it last?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't experienced any morning stiffness in my elbow. The stiffness and pain are more related to using my elbow throughout the day at work. It doesn't really bother me in the morning.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any clicking, locking, or popping sensations in your left elbow during movement?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any clicking, locking, or popping in my left elbow when I move it. It just feels stiff and painful, especially after I've been typing all day.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any redness, warmth, or fever associated with the left elbow pain and swelling?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Yes, there is some redness and warmth around my left elbow, and I've been experiencing pain and swelling, but I haven't had a fever. It feels warm to the touch, and the area looks a little red.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any clicking, locking, or popping sensations in your left elbow when moving it?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any clicking, locking, or popping sensations in my left elbow when moving it. It just feels stiff and painful, especially after I've been typing all day.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you had any recent blood tests or imaging studies for your left elbow, such as an X-ray, MRI, or blood tests for inflammation markers (e.g., ESR, CRP) or autoimmune conditions (e.g., rheumatoid factor)?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any blood tests or imaging studies for my left elbow. The only test I had was an endoscopy for my ulcer, which showed gastritis. I didn't know I needed anything else for my elbow.
